name: Stoley's Shipment
summary: Stoley’s Shipment is a stolen cargo of rum held by pirates in Lost Rigger Cove. Stoley wants it back to settle a wager with “Sea Wolf” MacKinley.

sections.title: Rum for a Wager
sections.body: In Lost Rigger Cove, Stoley’s Shipment lies among the pirates’ stolen cargo. Captain Cuergo took Stoley’s last rum and keeps it in the walled pirate town. Stoley needs the shipment returned to Steamwheedle Port so he can settle his wager with “Sea Wolf” MacKinley in Booty Bay.

faq.answer: Stoley’s Shipment is a stolen cargo of rum that Captain Cuergo took from Stoley.
Captain Cuergo stole Stoley’s last shipment of rum.
Stoley’s Shipment is kept in the walled pirate town at Lost Rigger Cove in Tanaris.

faq.q: Why does Stoley want the shipment back?
faq.answer: Stoley wants the rum back so he can settle a wager with “Sea Wolf” MacKinley in Booty Bay.
“Sea Wolf” MacKinley is the Booty Bay sailor with whom Stoley made a wager about Kalimdor’s rum.
